Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: isolated FRONT-view concept of one left-foot priest sandal for modular fantasy RPG 3D modeling.
Input image 1 is the existing male priest full-character concept, DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY. Extract and redraw his brown leather sandal faithfully, as a single empty wearable sandal with convincing foot-shaped volume. Keep the original modest functional fantasy design, warm medium brown leather, dark layered flat leather sole, multiple broad leather straps crossing over the forefoot and instep, narrow central longitudinal connector with small silver rivets, heel retention strap, and broad ankle cuff with a small round silver medallion centered on its FRONT. The ankle cuff has a rounded leather backing tab behind the medallion as in the reference. Preserve the silver rivets and small attachment fittings, restraint of ornament, original palette, strap layout and exposed open toe. Do not redesign into a boot or add gold priest insignia.
Composition: exactly ONE sandal, for the wearer's LEFT foot only, direct straight FRONT elevation, toe pointing directly toward camera, heel behind, nearly orthographic with no rotation or 3/4 angle. Full ankle cuff and whole sole visible, centered large with ample clean margin. Camera at instep height, just high enough to make the front straps readable without becoming a top-down view. Anatomically shaped left-foot sole suitable for later mirrored duplication to the right foot; do not draw a pair. Preserve naturally arched straps and hollow ankle cuff, clearly empty openings. The same single sandal will later be shown from its outer side in a separate image.
Style: polished realistic fantasy equipment concept rendering with crisp readable construction, leather grain and edge stitching, subdued silver hardware, soft even studio lighting on pure white background; no floor and no exterior cast shadow.
Constraints: sandal ONLY, NO foot, toes, toenails, skin, leg, ankle, human, mannequin, trousers, chainmail, socks or inserts. All spaces previously occupied by foot or chainmail are empty, with white backdrop visible through open straps. Keep believable leather thickness and coherent connected construction, not a flattened pile. No second sandal, no multi-view sheet, no text, dimensions, annotations, arrows, logos or watermark. No additions of weapons, robes, mitre, jewelry or ornate armor.
